abstract: Covers Universally Unique IDentifiers (UUIDs). RFC 9562 Universally Unique IDentifiers (UUIDs) is current; RFC 4122 A Universally Unique IDentifier (UUID) URN Namespace is legacy. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
